library_preparation_preflight.summary: The failure is an NPE inside Netty 4.2's default AdaptivePoolingAllocator$Chunk.<init> during native-image runs. That is repairable through metadata or test-code fixes, not through extra dependencies, Docker images, or environment properties. This is based on the issue log only; I did not inspect the Netty 4.2.1 sources or the resolved artifact.
risks: Netty 4.2 switched the default allocator to the adaptive one, so the NPE may trace to missing reachability metadata or Unsafe/ByteBuffer-related initialization rather than to the library itself. Diagnose it from the native-image run before touching the tests.
If metadata cannot cover the allocator failure, selecting a different allocator in the tests (for example via the io.netty.allocator.type system property) is an untested fallback.
